[ASSISTANT_SAID] The egg freezing process typically takes around 2-3 weeks and includes the following steps: Initial Consultation, Ovulation Induction, Egg Retrieval, Egg Freezing, and Storage.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Initial Consultation involves meeting with a fertility specialist to discuss medical history and fertility goals.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ovulation Induction involves hormone medications to stimulate the ovaries to produce multiple eggs, usually taking 10-14 days.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Egg Retrieval is a minor surgical procedure performed under light sedation, taking about 30 minutes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Egg Freezing uses a process called vitrification to preserve the structure and quality of the eggs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Storage of frozen eggs occurs in a fertility clinic or cryobank for future use.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The average total cost of egg freezing ranges from $10,000 to $20,000 or more, broken down into: Initial consultation ($100-$500), Ovulation induction medications ($1,000-$3,000), Egg retrieval procedure ($5,000-$10,000), Egg freezing and storage ($1,000-$3,000 initial fee + $500-$1,000 per year for storage fees).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User's age plays a significant role in fertility, with younger women having a higher success rate for egg freezing.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Success rates of frozen eggs resulting in a live birth vary by age: Under 35 (40-50% per egg), 35-37 (30-40% per egg), 38-40 (20-30% per egg), 41-42 (10-20% per egg), 43 and older (less than 10% per egg).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Factors affecting success rates include age at the time of egg freezing, egg quality, thawing and fertilization rates, embryo quality, number of eggs frozen, egg storage duration, and the expertise of the fertility clinic.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Common side effects of ovulation induction medications include mild to moderate bloating, breast tenderness, mood swings, headaches, fatigue, and nausea.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Risks associated with egg retrieval include mild discomfort, bruising, swelling, mild to moderate cramping, and potential emotional and psychological effects.
